about.heading: Strategy, media buying and design in one person.
paragraphs: I’m Muhammad Awais Rustam, a Digital Marketing Specialist and Graphic Designer based in Doha, Qatar. For more than seven years I’ve helped brands grow through paid social, search, SEO, email and WhatsApp marketing, always measured against leads and revenue rather than likes.

Today I lead digital marketing and design for Target Group, a Qatari group of three industrial companies: Target Metal Forming, Target Furniture Factory and Target Trading & Contracting. My focus there is B2B: contractors, fit-out firms and designers who buy stainless steel, wood panels and hardware. I generate more than 200 qualified B2B leads a month and work them through to sales.
Because I design my own creatives, campaigns move fast. The idea, the visual, the targeting and the reporting all come from the same desk.

results.heading: Case studies
results.intro: Three engagements that show how I work: clear goals, disciplined budgets and numbers you can check.

items.title: Building a B2B lead engine for an industrial group
paragraphs: Target supplies stainless steel, wood panels, fit-out systems and CNC metal fabrication to Qatar’s construction and interiors market. Its buyers are contractors, fit-out companies and interior designers, not consumers. I run the full funnel for all three group companies: lead campaigns on Meta and Google, WhatsApp follow-up, lead qualification and hand-off to the sales team.
I also design every post on the group’s Instagram, keeping one consistent look across metals, wood and hardware product lines.

items.bigLabel: leads a month across all courses
items.title: Scaling enrolments on a QAR 60,000 monthly budget
paragraphs: Leaders runs professional, safety, IT and language courses. I managed four ad accounts and a monthly budget of QAR 60,000, planned bottom-up from lead targets and cost per lead. I analysed more than 50 campaigns on CTR, CPC, CPL, ROAS and lead-to-sale ratio, and shifted budget and creative based on what converted.
items.splitNote: Monthly budget split, 75% Meta and 25% Google. Meta delivered 4,000–4,500 leads a month and Google 1,500–2,000.

items.bigLabel: return on ad spend on collection launches
items.title: Retail campaigns that sell
paragraphs: For fashion and jewellery brands including RJ’s Pret and Funky Fish, I ran Facebook and Instagram campaigns for seasonal and limited-edition collections that consistently returned more than three times their ad spend. Remarketing and product-focused content lifted conversion rates by 20%.
For Qatar retail brands such as Habari Hypermarket, I planned daily and seasonal campaign calendars for Ramadan, Eid and National Day, and ran hyperlocal ads that brought customers into stores.
